content.text:
Machine: Horizontal LPCVD tube furnace for semiconductor wafer deposition (silicon nitride, polysilicon, oxide)
Time unit: year
Component: Heating element: the resistive heater coils around the furnace tube
Fault mode: ageing: the resistive wire oxidises and thins with time at temperature until it fails

Give the life range of this component under this fault mode.

unit.description:
The given time unit, or the unit of an amount processed.

{minLength: 1}
unit.title: Unit

system.text:
You estimate how long a machine component lasts before it must be replaced, cleaned or restored, for one way it degrades. No document states this life; your range becomes a deliberately wide prior that measured data will narrow later, so state honestly how uncertain it is.

Give the range as the 5th and 95th percentile (`low`, `high`) of the life across machines like this one in normal service, under the given fault mode only:
- `unit`: the machine's time unit you are given, as written there. Use instead the unit of an amount processed (litres or cubic metres of water treated, kilograms, cycles) only when the life of this kind of component is normally stated as such an amount, as for a water filter's capacity. Never a calendar unit (day, month, year) unless it is the time unit you are given.
- `low` and `high`: numbers in that unit, low below high. Prefer a wide range to a narrow wrong one; a factor of ten between them is normal for a component class.
- `basis`: one or two sentences on the component class and conditions the range rests on. Do not cite manufacturer documents or numbers you have not been given.

responses.text: {"life":{"unit":"year","low":1.5,"high":12},"basis":"Resistive Kanthal-type or nickel-chromium heater coils in a horizontal LPCVD tube furnace run near 600–900 °C for years, often continuously, and oxidise and thin under that load. Life depends strongly on set-point temperature, thermal cycling, and any atmosphere or contamination exposure, so this is a deliberately wide prior that measured data should narrow."}

{"life":{"unit":"year","low":1.0,"high":8.0},"basis":"Resistive heater wire in a horizontal LPCVD tube furnace, typically an iron-chromium-aluminium alloy run near 800 to 1100 °C for long continuous campaigns, where oxidation and thinning set the end of life. The range assumes a constant-temperature duty with occasional thermal cycling and no mechanical or contamination damage. It is a deliberately wide prior, since element life depends strongly on operating temperature, duty cycle, and the furnace's atmosphere and maintenance history."}
